description: Clean-boot budget for the userspace-DWM desktop (limine_dwm.conf). Proves the acceptance goal of Phase 1: the plain desktop kernel embeds assets/dwm/default.toml (empty [startup]), so gui_server boots into an interactive but WINDOWLESS session — panel/dock/launcher/wallpaper/widgets are live and presenting — without autostarting any test windows or a terminal. `startup=0` traces the empty startup list to the resolved config; `desktop ready` proves the compositor reached a presenting state; the forbidden `served two untrusted clients OK` proves NO test clients were autostarted (that isolation smoke lives only in the boot-smoke-tests kernel / test.toml). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/gui_boot_markers.json --ready-marker 'gui_server: desktop ready'. The GUI kernel never prints [TERM-007], so --ready-marker MUST be overridden as shown.

required.claim: compositor process launched by the kernel GUI branch

required.marker: gui_server: no startup apps to autostart
required.claim: empty [startup] honored — no test windows/terminal autostarted
resolved DWM config has an empty startup list (data-driven clean boot)

required.marker: gui_server: panel edge=top tray edge=top tray_size=28
required.claim: Phase 5 panel/tray edges resolved from [panel]/[tray] in default.toml (default top/top → byte-identical layout)
desktop reached an interactive, presenting state with zero windows

forbidden.why: test-client autostart must NOT happen on the clean desktop; the M3 isolation smoke belongs to the boot-smoke-tests kernel (test.toml)
any gui_server self-test failure during bring-up
